LOOM EXPLAIN -- Multilang Normalized
==================================
manifest sha256: c6b8c16dffcb39bacec04c3d1130e7c93c0a1f48fa82f9399483202e3b968075
3 source(s) | 1 target(s) | 14 plan step(s)

SOURCES  (file facts are probed, never typed -- ADR-5)
  main: wavs/main.wav
    declared: kind bed, layout 7.1.4, order bs2051
    probed:   12 ch, 48000 Hz, 24-bit, 4800 frames, sha256 2d8b61cc3976
  vo_de: wavs/vo_de.wav
    declared: kind bed, layout stereo, order bs2051
    probed:   2 ch, 48000 Hz, 24-bit, 4800 frames, sha256 5f295631b348
  vo_en: wavs/vo_en.wav
    declared: kind bed, layout stereo, order bs2051
    probed:   2 ch, 48000 Hz, 24-bit, 4800 frames, sha256 5f295631b348

POLICY  (as resolved)
  codec: opus  (coupled 128000 bps, uncoupled 64000 bps)
  loudness: measure -- embedded loudness values are measured at
    execution on rendered layouts (BS.1770), never typed
  normalize: -16 LUFS -- gain-ride the source, then re-measure the ridden
    audio; accept within +/-0.3 LU; clip guard: ridden digital peak must stay
    below -0.05 dBFS (Loom is not a limiter)
  profile: auto -- derived per target from element/channel arithmetic
  validate: fail_on_error -- every output passes through the Sentinel gate at
    run time (L3 rendered QC when oracles are present); findings S-320/S-321
    escalate to run-failing on Loom-packaged outputs

TARGET 1/1: dist/multilang_norm.iamf
  format: iamf   profile: base   backend: iamftools
  why this route:
    raw .iamf: iamf-tools primary (ADR-1 — native BS.1770 measured loudness,
    profile control)
  steps (execution order):
     1. s00-stage-0-main  [stage_input, internal]
        from $SRCDIR/wavs/main.wav; to $WORK/wav/main.wav
        why: single input_wav_directory for encoder_main; staged copy pins the
          bytes the plan's source hash refers to
     2. s00-stage-1-vo_en  [stage_input, internal]
        from $SRCDIR/wavs/vo_en.wav; to $WORK/wav/vo_en.wav
        why: single input_wav_directory for encoder_main; staged copy pins the
          bytes the plan's source hash refers to
     3. s00-stage-2-vo_de  [stage_input, internal]
        from $SRCDIR/wavs/vo_de.wav; to $WORK/wav/vo_de.wav
        why: single input_wav_directory for encoder_main; staged copy pins the
          bytes the plan's source hash refers to
     4. t00-multilang_norm-cfg-pre  [write_config, internal]
        to $WORK/cfg/t00-multilang_norm-pre.textproto
        why: R3 pass-A: pre-ride encode config (loudness measured on the
          un-ridden program)
     5. t00-multilang_norm-enc-pre  [encode, encoder_main]
        writes
          $WORK/norm/t00-multilang_norm/enc-pre/t00-multilang_norm-pre.iamf
        why: R3 pass-A encode; never a deliverable
     6. t00-multilang_norm-render-anchor-pre  [render, decoder_main]
        writes $WORK/norm/t00-multilang_norm/anchor-pre.wav
        why: R3: reference-render the anchor layout (stereo — the first
          effective loudness layout) pre-ride of the anchor presentation
          (mix_presentation_id pinned — D-Z6)
     7. t00-multilang_norm-measure-anchor-pre  [measure_bs1770, sentinel-dsp]
        why: R3: pre-ride BS.1770-4 on the anchor render (sentinel-dsp kernel
          — conformant engine, F34); the ride gain derives from THIS
          measurement only
     8. t00-multilang_norm-ride-0-main  [gain_ride, ffmpeg]
        writes $WORK/wavn/t00-multilang_norm/main.wav
        resolves at execution:
          ${gain:t00-multilang_norm-measure-anchor-pre:-16.00}
        why: R3 gain-ride to -16 LUFS (gain = target - measured, resolved at
          execution; clip guard: ridden digital peak must stay below -0.05
          dBFS — Loom is not a limiter); R8: every stem rides by the same gain
          — riding all stems by g dB rides every rendered mix by g dB (linear
          mixing)
     9. t00-multilang_norm-ride-1-vo_en  [gain_ride, ffmpeg]
        writes $WORK/wavn/t00-multilang_norm/vo_en.wav
        resolves at execution:
          ${gain:t00-multilang_norm-measure-anchor-pre:-16.00}
        why: R3 gain-ride to -16 LUFS (gain = target - measured, resolved at
          execution; clip guard: ridden digital peak must stay below -0.05
          dBFS — Loom is not a limiter); R8: every stem rides by the same gain
          — riding all stems by g dB rides every rendered mix by g dB (linear
          mixing)
    10. t00-multilang_norm-ride-2-vo_de  [gain_ride, ffmpeg]
        writes $WORK/wavn/t00-multilang_norm/vo_de.wav
        resolves at execution:
          ${gain:t00-multilang_norm-measure-anchor-pre:-16.00}
        why: R3 gain-ride to -16 LUFS (gain = target - measured, resolved at
          execution; clip guard: ridden digital peak must stay below -0.05
          dBFS — Loom is not a limiter); R8: every stem rides by the same gain
          — riding all stems by g dB rides every rendered mix by g dB (linear
          mixing)
    11. t00-multilang_norm-cfg  [write_config, internal]
        to $WORK/cfg/t00-multilang_norm.textproto
        why: original textproto emitter (D-L6); loudness fields absent —
          encoder_main measures natively (G2b)
    12. t00-multilang_norm-enc  [encode, encoder_main]
        writes $WORK/enc/t00-multilang_norm/t00-multilang_norm.iamf
        why: raw .iamf: iamf-tools primary (ADR-1 — native BS.1770 measured
          loudness, profile control)
    13. t00-multilang_norm-verify  [verify_loudness, internal]
        why: R3 accept: the anchor-layout loudness that encoder_main
          independently measured on the ridden audio must land within ±0.3 LU
          of the normalize target (read back from the bitstream via the
          sentinel clean-room parser)
    14. t00-multilang_norm-out  [copy, internal]
        from $WORK/enc/t00-multilang_norm/t00-multilang_norm.iamf; to
          $OUTDIR/dist/multilang_norm.iamf
        why: deliver the encoder output to the target path

NOTES
  $TOOLCHAIN / $WORK / $OUTDIR / $SRCDIR are execution-time roots; plans are
    environment-portable and contain no absolute paths.
  ${measure:...} / ${gain:...} tokens are data-dependent plan edges: their
    values come from BS.1770-4 measurements made during execution (computed,
    never typed -- ADR-5).
